_comment: ROM hacks that ship as an xdelta patch for the North American Super Mario Sunshine disc. tools/mods/romhack.py applies one to the player's own image and checks the result; SMS Launcher reads this file for its list. source_md5 is the disc the patch is made for, result_md5 the disc it makes. code_mod names the port's code-mod build option, if the hack carries Kuribo code (see docs/ROMHACKS.md).

romhacks.name: Super Mario Sunburn
romhacks.author: EpicWade
romhacks.notes: Kuribo code (win condition, back nozzle, Eclipse's Yoshi patches) is not ported yet; the patched disc's files and audio load as data.
